Maya wanted a cat. Their client's shop cat, Biscuit, sleeps in the window, so she chose a calm, sitting cat with big pointy ears. Tom laid the outline from the start domino, up the left side, over the ears and the neck dip, then down the right. Priya waited with the tail, set to start where "the outline ends on the right." Tom's line was still running, so she kept waiting. "No rush, Tom, I'll wait," she said.

Near the end, Tom's line reached the base and Priya's tail began to run. Leo checked the ear tips, and Maya looked closely at the tail join. Everyone agreed the chain carried through from start to tip. Tom added that the client wanted something calm and friendly. Maya called it: "Hands off everyone, we're done."

When the start domino was pushed, all 91 of 91 dominoes fell. Everyone at the table had said cat. The blind judges guessed a cat too, but also a vase, a bottle, and a person in a robe.
